remote_commit_observed_with: GitHub plugin fetch_commit, then independently read fetched immutable Git objects
full_input_manifest_encoding: UTF-8 json.dumps(path_to_sha256, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon)), ensure_ascii=True, no trailing newline

p7_byte_identical_adoption.review_basis: Original P7 review records and hashes remain fixed; all 12 adopted source/test paths are byte-identical to PR144. Existing limitations remain in force.

crates/cc-eval/src/benchmark/p8_load.rs.change: Replace deprecated AtomicU64::fetch_update with a compare_exchange_weak loop; add two boundary/concurrency unit tests.
findings: Initial load is Acquire; successful CAS is AcqRel and failed CAS is Acquire, matching the original fetch_update orderings.
Every failed CAS supplies the observed counter used by the next checked_add and limit comparison; overflow or exhaustion returns before changing the counter.
Production uses of the counter only initialize it and monotonically reserve via this CAS; no decrement can invalidate early exhaustion.
Zero-byte reservations preserve the counter; a write failure after reservation remains conservatively charged, as before.
The usize-to-u64 conversion is unchanged and exact on the supported 32/64-bit targets.

crates/cc-eval/src/benchmark/statistics..change: Use one private nearest_rank helper in distribution and quantile_interval.
findings: The ceil(quantile * len)-1, saturating subtraction, and upper clamp expression is unchanged.
distribution uses only 0.5 and 0.95; quantile_interval retains its prior empty/non-(0,1)/NaN rejection before calling the helper.
The get/copy lookup replaces an index already proved in bounds; empty distributions remain None.
The binomial interval endpoints, confidence, sample sorting, and tail classification are unchanged.

crates/cc-eval/src/bin/cc-eval.rs.change: Three-way union of the P7 AblateStrategies CLI and P8 Compare receipt handling.
findings: Relative to P8, the only changes are the AblateStrategies enum variant and its dispatcher.
Relative to P7, the P8 Write import and exclusive create_new comparison receipt implementation are preserved exactly.
No command routing, comparison error status, or raw-output overwrite behavior was dropped.

crates/cc-eval/tests/p8_measurements.rs.change: Add independent integer nearest-rank oracle regression.
findings: Expected p50/p95 ranks use integer div_ceil rather than the implementation floating-point expression.
Covers lengths 1,2,3,19,20,21,199,200,201 with unsorted, repeated, and zero timings.
Checks both distribution and interval point estimates plus empty/invalid quantile inputs; existing interval-bound tests remain.

rust_tests.scope_note: Static review and independent immutable-blob/hash verification are not fresh Rust test, Clippy, MSRV, or CI executions. Parent-agent execution receipts must retain their actual source/toolchain and outcomes.

known_unresolved_boundaries: Full combined-source CI and current stable/MSRV execution require their own actual results; original PR144 or PR145 receipts do not certify this new source.

The existing Linux sampler live_child_snapshot_is_attributed_monotonic_and_disappears depends on readable /proc/PID mappings, process scheduling, and bounded readiness; earlier container PID/proc failures remain a validation risk and are not skipped or marked passed by this review.
The inherited GC collect/mark/unlink path has no publication-spanning filesystem lock; its documented replacement/publication race is not repaired or certified closed here.
The CAS counter measures reserved bytes; I/O failure after reservation can retain consumed budget and partial artifacts, preserving the previous conservative semantics.
Nearest-rank consolidation does not certify IID timings, tail coverage, performance improvement, full 1k-100k matrices, or long soak.
Public semantic strategy includes local lanes. No live provider, optional LLM judging, holdout quality, real costs, or release approval was executed or established.
conclusion: Accepted only for the fixed 16-path source evolution and byte-identical P7 adoption described above. Independent source integrity and code review found no introduced correctness blocker in CAS accounting, CLI union, or nearest-rank consolidation; broader acceptance depends on actual validation and the existing gate requirements.
